report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces returned HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment and postgres save_order, and order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders with zero 502s. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish a deployment-caused fault. No bounded cause is substantiated; hand off for further evidence.
missing_evidence: Error-level order and gateway logs (excluded from context) to confirm whether checkout errors occurred at all

Deployment history showing a version change preceding the alert window, if any
Trace samples containing non-2xx status codes or error results
